svg.title: Choosing on the reveal changes the answer
svg.desc: Both routes revealed the pillow. The 7B model selected the box after returning and the laptop when selecting on the reveal.
svg.text: Choosing on the reveal changes the answer
Select the marked object closest to the Pillow.
Mark 1: Box · Mark 2: Laptop Correct object: Box
Turns follow the scripted route. The model selects from the full ordered image history.
